entry.name: Minimalism command run returns a delete-list and writes nothing
entry.expected: A /cad-minimalism-review run against a named target returns a ranked delete-list in the reviewer findings shape ({file,line,severity,claim,failure_scenario}, ordered blocker->low, target named in the opening line), and `git status --short` is byte-identical before and after the run.
entry.why_human: Out of reach, not merely unprobed: settling it requires invoking the /cad-minimalism-review slash command, which dispatches a live cad-reviewer subagent through the spawn-agent seam and appends real lifecycle events to .planning/trace.jsonl. A verifier cannot invoke a slash command, and the run mutates the shared run record, which this pass is barred from doing. CONTEXT AC3 marks it human-verify for this reason.

entry.name: Cadence-directed capture lands outside the host project
entry.expected: A /cad-capture --cadence run from inside a non-Cadence host project appends `- <date> <text> (host: <origin url or repo basename>, command: /cad-<name>)` to ~/.claude/cadence/CAPTURE.md (or CADENCE_GLOBAL_CONFIG's directory), while the host repo's .planning/CAPTURE.md and `git status --short` are both unchanged and no commit is made in either tree.
entry.why_human: Out of reach: it needs a slash-command invocation from inside a different repository on the user's machine, and its whole subject is a write to the user's home directory outside every project boundary. A verifier may not mutate that state, and the arm is prose over granted Write/Bash with no seam or test to exercise instead. CONTEXT AC4 marks it human-verify.

entry.name: /cad-suggest presents figures and writes no config
entry.expected: /cad-suggest on this repo presents an opening scope + events_read line, then each `suggest` entry numbered with its subject, its verbatim seam evidence and its config key (e.g. workflow.max_plan_tasks, model.effort.cad-plan-checker), each `info` entry as one receipt line, and leaves .planning/config.json and the global Cadence config byte-identical.
entry.why_human: Out of reach: the seam half is already settled by probe (trace suggest returns 285 events and 3 suggestions carrying real schema keys), but what the command PRESENTS is produced by a slash-command invocation this verifier cannot make. CONTEXT AC6 marks it human-verify.

entry.name: /cad-suggest refuses a thin trace in one line
entry.expected: Run against a .planning/ whose trace is absent or below the evidence floors, /cad-suggest emits exactly one refusal line and zero suggestions - 'no events in the scope read' for events_read: 0, or 'N events read, none cleared the floors' for a non-zero read - and states no floor figure.
entry.why_human: Out of reach: the seam's thin return is probed ({"ok":true,"scope":"all","events_read":0,"suggestions":[]}), but 'exactly one line' is a property of the command's rendered output, reachable only by invoking the slash command against a scratch .planning/. CONTEXT AC6 marks it human-verify.
